records.trigger: red_evidence_required: bug fix work (false OUT_OF_SCOPE classification of acceptance-topology story artifacts)
records.observedFailure: Against the story baseline build, classifyLifecycleArtifact returns null for all four acceptance-topology story artifacts (.lattice/story/actives/B-5e4a/acceptance-basis.json, pre-review-check.json, topology-critic-receipt.json, topology-exclusion-approvals.json), so classifyScopePath reports category=unknown rule=out_of_scope allowed=false and the scope gate blocks. Live confirmation in this very story: scope_contract_check flags OUT_OF_SCOPE on .lattice/story/actives/B-5e4a/acceptance-basis.json immediately after acceptance_basis_generate wrote it. The harness reports 4/8 FAIL and exits 1; the four negative controls (arbitrary basename, unregistered basename variant, traversal path, non-canonical story id) pass at baseline and must keep passing after the fix, so the harness cannot be satisfied by opening the closed set.
records.note: Same harness is red and green: exit 1 at baseline (4/8), must exit 0 (8/8) after CHK-001 registers the four filenames. Controls pin the closed-set trust policy.
